title: Bates Motel (TV series)
production_companies: Cuse ProductionsFirst credited as American Genre in 2013, and later Carlton Cuse Productions from 2014 to 2015.
premise_summary: Bates Motel is an American psychological horror drama television series based on characters from the 1959 novel Psycho by Robert Bloch that aired on A&E from March 18, 2013, to April 24, 2017. It was developed by Carlton Cuse, Kerry Ehrin, and Anthony Cipriano.
